policy: Only source-verified rules with passing validation cases may be enabled.

rules.statement: The article states that wherever natal Mars is placed, it implements/activates the 10th house from itself in the native's 27th year.
rules.source_author: Saptarishis Astrology article page: byline metadata credits Vinayak Bhatt; article title attributes the piece to Venkat Ramana
rules.source_title: Bhrighu Saral Paddathi – 6 (BSP-6: Mars Tenth house rule)
rules.source_location: Article opening, paragraphs beginning 'One of such techniques...' and 'BSP -6...' (page lines 42-50); worked examples lines 53-89

trigger.counting: inclusive house counting; natal Mars house is counted as 1

rules.confidence: Medium-low: direct Saptarishis publication with multiple worked examples; byline/title attribution is inconsistent and examples are not independently chart-recomputed here.

validation_case.limitation: Source examples provide natal house placements and claimed events, but no machine-readable chart longitudes or independent ephemeris validation.
